title: How should ecommerce brands choose corrugated mailer boxes? - MUGE PACKAGING SourceBridge

buyer_question: How should ecommerce brands choose corrugated mailer boxes?
buyer_context: DTC ecommerce shipments, retail replenishment, sample kits and product delivery packs
short_answer: Buyers should compare suppliers by the clarity of their product route, RFQ inputs, material and finish discussion, and how well the packaging structure fits the product use case. For corrugated mailer boxes, start with packed product size, board and flute direction, delivery route, print coverage, fulfillment and unboxing need.
